name: Rename Keys
label: Rename JSON keys
description: In-process key rename via mappings or regex. No network. No eval.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Rename Keys operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'rename'.

schema.label: item
schema.description: Object or array of objects. Required.

schema.label: mappings
schema.description: JSON array of from->to strings (e.g. ["name->fullName"]) or {from,to} objects.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: rename. Required. Example: 'rename'.

configurationParameters.label: Mappings
configurationParameters.description: JSON array of from->to strings or {from,to} objects. Example: '["n->name"]' or '[{"from":"n","to":"name"}]'.

configurationParameters.label: Regex
configurationParameters.description: Treat from as a regex. Default false.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
